statement: Let N be an s-t network on exactly 4 vertices in which every arc has capacity 1 and whose maximum flow value F is positive. Then every maximum s-t flow of N assigns positive flow to at least F+1 arcs.
definitions: An s-t network is a finite loopless digraph on the stated vertex set (isolated vertices permitted) with s != t and a positive integer capacity on each arc; a maximum flow is a flow of maximum value F; 'assigns positive flow to an arc' means f(a) > 0.
